data.narrative:
Ares Industries is a Series A-stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security that has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing, all operating in the same sector at similar stages.

Two primary valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $62M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) produces a median implied valuation of $400M, though the range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion in the peer set. The peer-median result is weighted more heavily given its basis in direct market transactions.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $53M (low) to $460M (high), with a median estimate of $231M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: peer comps in Defense & Security show high variance in realized valuations, and Ares' specific differentiation relative to incumbents and frontier competitors remains a key driver of where within this band the company likely settles. Stage, capital deployment pace, and technology differentiation will be critical to resolution.
